answer: At the dawn of each epoch, validators commit staking collateral subject to quadratic slashing penalties that scale super-linearly. This creates a canyon of negative expected utility for Sybil clusters, as the capital commitment required to influence consensus climbs to a zenith of exponential expenditure. By pairing zero-knowledge verifiable delays with these slashing rules, the protocol guarantees that the marginal attack cost always exceeds any extractable value, enforcing a robust Nash equilibrium.
